q: How do I calculate emissions from milling and resurfacing a road?
title: Road resurfacing emissions per km
short: Add diesel for the milling machine, paver, rollers and tippers to the emissions of the hot mix laid, from the asphalt plant's fuel per tonne and the bitumen. Reusing milled material in new mix cuts virgin bitumen and aggregate. Divide by lane km.
audience: Road contractors and public works departments

ul: Diesel per shift for each machine.
Asphalt plant fuel and electricity per tonne.
Share of reclaimed asphalt in the mix.

p: Keep site machinery diesel and the material footprint as separate lines, so a buyer can compare contractors fairly.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.

sources.label: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard
